scope: Real PMC OA full-text biomedical evidence relevant to older-adult care and aging-related assistance. NOT a generic biomedical corpus.

topics.search_terms: (dementia OR "Alzheimer disease" OR "mild cognitive impairment" OR "cognitive decline" OR "memory loss") AND ("older adults" OR aged OR elderly OR geriatric)
topics.rationale: Core older-adult cognition domain; high caregiver-relevance.

topics.search_terms: (polypharmacy OR deprescribing OR "adverse drug" OR "drug interaction" OR "medication safety") AND ("older adults" OR aged OR elderly OR geriatric)
topics.rationale: High burden and avoidable harm in older adults; central to ElderDocAI assistance.

topics.search_terms: (exercise OR "physical activity" OR balance OR walking OR frailty OR sarcopenia OR "physical function") AND ("older adults" OR aged OR elderly OR geriatric)
topics.rationale: Function and mobility are core geriatric outcomes and caregiver-relevant.

topics.search_terms: (nutrition OR diet OR malnutrition OR "dietary protein" OR "healthy aging") AND ("older adults" OR aged OR elderly OR geriatric)
topics.rationale: Nutrition underlies function, immunity, and chronic disease in older adults.

topics.search_terms: (caregiver OR caregiving OR "caregiver burden" OR "caregiver support") AND (dementia OR "older adults" OR aged OR elderly)
topics.rationale: Directly aligned with ElderDocAI's caregiver-facing purpose.

exclusion_concepts: single-organ acute protocols without geriatric framing
topics.search_terms: (falls OR frailty OR delirium OR incontinence OR "pressure ulcer" OR immobility) AND ("older adults" OR aged OR elderly OR geriatric)
topics.rationale: Geriatric syndromes are markers of vulnerability and care complexity.

topics.topic_name: Chronic conditions relevant to older-adult care
topics.search_terms: (multimorbidity OR comorbidity OR "heart failure" OR hypertension OR diabetes OR COPD OR osteoporosis) AND ("older adults" OR aged OR elderly OR geriatric)
topics.rationale: Chronic disease management dominates older-adult care activity.

topics.search_terms: ("activities of daily living" OR "independent living" OR "healthy aging" OR "functional decline") AND ("older adults" OR aged OR elderly OR geriatric)
topics.rationale: Function and independence are the central outcomes of supportive care.

topics.topic_name: Preventive and supportive care relevant to older adults
topics.search_terms: ("geriatric assessment" OR "advance care planning" OR "home care" OR "long-term care" OR "falls prevention" OR vaccination) AND ("older adults" OR aged OR elderly OR geriatric)
topics.rationale: Preventive/supportive care scope complements curative domains.
